verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a first-party CLI (posthog-cli) installable via npx, usable from terminal, coding agents, scripts, and CI/CD with headless auth, plus a probe confirming the docs page is live; it integrates with the MCP tool catalog and supports source-map upload, schema management, and task CRUD. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the CLI itself (only vendor docs and a probe corroborate it).
